## About
Kiki Landscaping & Construction is based out of League City. Our focus has always been on creating stunning landscapes for all to enjoy, whether that's a first home's front yard, an HOA's common areas or a school, church or office.
Kiki runs the company as President, with Kaylin as Chief Financial Officer, Trevor as Chief Operations Officer and Bryce Dugie as Office Manager. Our crews wear company uniforms, our blades are sharpened and our mowers are greased daily, so you'll know when we've been there.
We value hard work, even when that means working in the rain or on a holiday. Neighbors have rated us 4.2 from 44 Google reviews.

## Services
- Commercial Lawn Maintenance: Full service lawn maintenance including mowing, trimming, clean-up, edging, fertilizing, mulching, pruning and manicuring shrubbery and trees, and seasonal color rotations.
- Commercial Landscaping: We can build a landscape with a variety of flowers, plants, trees, or whatever else your property needs.
- HOA Grounds Maintenance: We want to partner with our local HOA's. We care about the residents in our community just as much as the Home Owners Association does. Small or large, we service them all.
- Landscaping and maintenance for your home: If your home needs landscaping or maintenance, we'll take care of it.
- Mulch, sod and seasonal flowers: Need new mulch, sod or seasonal flowers? We can come install it all for you.
- Monthly maintenance: Just need someone to keep the yard up month to month? We can do that too.
- Garden pergolas: One longtime customer wrote that we built garden pergolas for them, along with designing and planting their landscaping.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you cover?
A: We're based out of League City and serve the surrounding areas, including LaPorte, Clear Lake, Kemah, Friendswood, Houston and Seabrook.

Q: What kinds of commercial properties do you work on?
A: Schools, churches, offices, apartments, government buildings, city offices, HOA's, and large or small commercial properties. We service them all.

Q: Do you take care of homes too?
A: Yes. If your home needs landscaping or maintenance, we can help, from new mulch, sod and seasonal flowers to regular monthly upkeep.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
